column1: # *** WHY IT IS THE BEST RECORD IN THE MONTEVIDEO FILE. ***
# One act, independently of the marriage of 1864, names BOTH SETS OF GRANDPARENTS outright. Everything
# this archive had inferred or taken from a tree about the generation above Luis Lerena Lenguas is
# stated here in a parish register: his father Luis, his mother Justiniana Lenguas; her father Candido,
# It also gives his full given names - LUIS EUGENIO - which no other record had.
# AND THE GODMOTHER IS THE JOIN BETWEEN THE TWO FAMILIES. Dona SIXTA LENGUAS is Candido Juanico's
# second wife, whom he married in 1857, and she is the SISTER of Justiniana Lenguas Gonzalez, the
# child's paternal grandmother. So the baby's godparents are her maternal grandfather and her paternal
# grandmother's sister, who are married to each other. The Lenguas married into both houses.
# *** AND STILL NOTHING TOUCHES PABLO ARMANDO LERENA. ***
